title.value: Trailhead: the CKEditor AI Coding Agents Webinar Demo

summary.value: The runnable companion to the \"Less time, fewer tokens, better effects\" webinar: a fictional trip-planning landing page whose About section is edited by a CKEditor InlineEditor that an AI coding agent wired in - Format painter, Slash commands, AI assistant, autosave and all.

value.description: Trailhead: the CKEditor AI Coding Agents Webinar Demo

content.value:
What's inside

Trailhead is a fictional backcountry trip-planning landing page. Most of it is fixed marketing content; the About section is the demo surface: a vanilla JavaScript InlineEditor using CKEditor's model-based editing pipeline (not raw DOM editing), premium Format painter and Slash commands, CKEditor AI when a token endpoint is configured, autosave to local storage with restore on load, and explicit save/reset controls.

Why it exists

Built for the webinar on the official CKEditor support for AI coding agents - the repo an agent equipped with the CKEditor skill and the docs MCP server helped assemble, so you can diff the promise against the code.
